name: Yamaha XJ650 Maxim
engine: 653 cc air-cooled DOHC inline four, four Hitachi carbs, shaft drive
intro: Yamaha's shaft-drive four. Smooth and tough, but the carbs and the YICS plugs need attention.

add.title: Check the YICS passage plugs
add.instructions: Look at both ends of the YICS passage in the cylinder head. The plugs must be there and sealed.
add.reason: A missing YICS plug causes starting and idle problems.

G: The Hitachi carbs on the XJ650 have small passages that clog in storage. Clean them all, not just the jets.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.

known.title: YICS plugs
known.what: Missing plugs at the ends of the YICS passage upset idle and starting.
